reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkEditableCategories filter and adds a predicate next to hasSavedTemplates, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own parallel filter chain rather than being routed through the shared selection.

duplication.why: The notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes typing are added to two separate queries and the fixed check is applied in two places (bulk filter and copyPreviousMonth's inline returns).

placement.why: All logic lives in budget/actions.ts beside the existing eligibility rules for month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the eligibility rule, its query support, one test and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: A named isFixedGroup predicate is easy to own, though the two selection paths still have to be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth already decided eligibility inline before the change; the diff keeps that pre-existing split rather than introducing a new bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated group-notes join and check are plain repetitions in getBudgetData/getBulkEditableCategories and copyPreviousMonth, not disguised.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts is the single definition of the tag rule, used by getBulkEditableCategories and copyPreviousMonth; the data needed for it is joined separately in both queries.
